races.paceDynamic: Salsinha will take them along from the front with minimal early pressure, as the field lacks genuine pace angles beyond Aruntothequeen who may sit prominent early. The tempo will be sustainable through the middle stages given the lack of natural speed in this maiden field, allowing the leaders to dictate terms. This sets up a sprint finish where horses need to be handy turning in, as those held up at the back will struggle to make up significant ground. The race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Salsinha and Aruntothequeen settle into an uncontested rhythm through halfway
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows the leaders to kick clear in the straight with plenty left in reserve. Hold-up horses get strung out behind the steady tempo and can't close the gap when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and bunches the field turning for home
scenarios.body: A sustained drive from the back half of the field can sweep up the leaders who went too slow early. This rewards horses with proven finishing kicks over genuine stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomers Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market signals strong confidence in the debutants or lightly-raced types
scenarios.body: Glendaars Crystal or Valverdeagain could possess significantly more ability than their initial marks suggest. Their inexperience at the trip gets negated by superior class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Salsinha goes too fast early under pressure from Aruntothequeen
scenarios.body: Both pace angles empty out badly in the final furlong, allowing a mid-division closer to pick up the pieces. The race becomes a test of who has anything left after the leaders fold.

races.paceDynamic: Fedneys Park will likely lead from the outset with Single Edition and Laurie Blue providing some early company, but this is fundamentally a front-runner's dream scenario. With 16 of 22 runners carrying hold-up styles and only one confirmed leader, Fedneys Park can dictate a comfortable tempo without pressure. The huge field will create positioning issues and traffic problems in the straight, particularly on Punchestown's turning track. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Fedneys Park gets an easy lead and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead runner can control the tempo completely and kick clear when the mood takes him, while the hold-up brigade get tangled up behind. Despite his recent fading tendency, the tactical advantage of a solo lead in this field size is enormous.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady but one of the prominent runners gets first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Single Edition or Laurie Blue can track the pace without getting involved in scrimmaging and have enough left to collar a tiring Fedneys Park. The clean journey from a forward position proves decisive in this cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps appear for a strong closer
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses like Hickeys Hill or Low Style finds racing room and benefits from a truly-run race where stamina tells. The winner needs both class and luck to navigate through 20+ horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Single Edition or Las Brisas Boy decide to challenge Fedneys Park early
scenarios.body: The early leaders go too fast trying to establish position and set it up for a hold-up horse with tactical pace like Amburana or Red Veil. Multiple pace angles collapse the race completely.

watchPoints.text: Fedneys Park getting an uncontested lead could make this a procession given the lack of other pace
Traffic problems in the straight with 22 runners will eliminate several chances regardless of ability
Single Edition and Laurie Blue's early positioning will determine if they can track or must challenge
Several horses like Redcliff Glen may not run as reserves, changing the race dynamics
Hickeys Hill's recent form upturn and light weight make him the pick of the hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Walk On Annilog will take this field along at a steady tempo with minimal early pressure, as most runners prefer to settle behind. Lakefield Flyer, Only A Dollar and Walk Win may track the leader but none are confirmed pace pressers. The lack of natural speed in this large field will create a sedate early gallop building to a cavalry charge finish. This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best work late, as the moderate early tempo will leave plenty in reserve for those who can quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Annilog gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The steady gallop will suit horses that need time to warm up and can produce their best late kick. Hold-up performers with proven finishing ability will have every chance to get competitive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Lakefield Flyer and Walk Win track closer to apply gradual pressure
scenarios.body: The pace lifts earlier creating a more searching test that favours prominent racers with stamina. Those who can travel well in the first half of the field will benefit from the stronger tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely slow with no one wanting to lead
scenarios.body: An excessively steady tempo creates a messy sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial. Horses with natural speed who can get a good position will have the edge in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Annilog goes too fast early or makes jumping errors
scenarios.body: The leader weakening could create gaps for those racing prominently to inherit. Horses tracking the pace who stay strongly will benefit from the front-runner's demise.

races.paceDynamic: That's It Paddy and Captains Speech will clash early as confirmed front-runners, with Vienna Storm, Lemmy Caution and Nopresentliketime likely tracking just behind in prominent positions. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing 3m trip, potentially softening up the leaders. With five horses comfortable racing prominently and several hold-up horses including The Rebel Fox and Papagei sitting off the pace, this sets up perfectly for closers to strike late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on the expected pace battle up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel early and the pace is genuinely strong over 3m
scenarios.body: The prominent pack gets drawn into the battle while hold-up horses conserve energy for a late charge. Closers with stamina reserves can exploit tired front-runners in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking horses can avoid the early pace battle and position perfectly
scenarios.body: Vienna Storm or Lemmy Caution can sit just off the leaders without getting involved, then strike when the pace-setters weaken. Elliott's tactical nous with Lemmy Caution could prove decisive here.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either That's It Paddy or Captains Speech gets an easy lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and save energy for a sustained kick, with 3m giving time to establish control. Captains Speech's higher rating suggests he could pull this off if getting first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexposed Horse Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Quest For Answers or Union Boy shows significant improvement from lightly-raced profiles
scenarios.body: Morris's newcomer or the complete unknown Union Boy could have untapped ability that renders form irrelevant. This maiden could spring a major surprise from the unknowns.

races.paceDynamic: Schiehallion will dictate proceedings from the front with minimal early pressure, allowing him to set a comfortable gallop through the first half of this 3m test. The prominent runners It's Time Again, Ballagh Star, Joe's Turn and Ossifer Hops will track the leader but are unlikely to apply serious pressure until turning for home. This creates a tactical race where the large contingent of hold-up horses including Go To Town, Cullig, Wakey Wakey Man and Where Are You Now will rely on Schiehallion maintaining his kick through the final stages. The sustainable early pace strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Schiehallion Sustains Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his gallop turning for home and the pace doesn't collapse completely.
scenarios.body: Schiehallion gets first run on his rivals while the prominent trackers It's Time Again and Ballagh Star are perfectly positioned to capitalize. The hold-up brigade face too much ground to make up against runners who've conserved energy in ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Schiehallion begins to tire in the final furlong and the race opens up for closers.
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace allows the classier hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks with Wakey Wakey Man and Go To Town having the tactical speed to win. Jack Kennedy's booking of Wakey Wakey Man looks particularly shrewd in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If It's Time Again or Ballagh Star apply pressure to Schiehallion turning for home.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on both the tiring leader and the hold-up horses still making ground from the rear. Ballagh Star's recent Punchestown win gives him a clear course advantage over his rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Schiehallion goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with any horse getting a clear run capable of winning in a blanket finish. The 21-runner field creates inevitable traffic problems that could derail several fancied runners.

watchPoints.text: Schiehallion's jumping - any mistake could end his chance of sustaining the gallop and open up the race completely.
Traffic problems in large 21-runner field - several hold-up horses including Go To Town and Cullig need clear runs.
It's Time Again and Ballagh Star applying early pressure to Schiehallion - could set up race for closers if they go too hard.
Wakey Wakey Man's position turning for home with Jack Kennedy - champion jockey's timing will be crucial to chances.
Three County Star and Halsafari running again within days - quick turnarounds could compromise their finishing efforts.

races.paceDynamic: The Cheeky Pup stands as the only confirmed front-runner in this 20-runner handicap hurdle, likely to dictate terms from the start without early pressure. Oogum Boogum and Written In My Soul should track closely as prominent runners, with Johnny M and Max Time also capable of pressing forward if needed. The large field of 15+ hold-up horses including Journey So Far, Mickey Hulie, and Annie Button will create a cavalry charge from the back straight, but the lack of early pace pressure means they'll need to make up significant ground. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and those capable of tracking the pace, as they'll have first run on the field when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Cheeky Pup sets sustainable fractions without being harassed early
scenarios.body: The pace trackers get first run turning for home before the backmarkers can organise their challenge. Written In My Soul and Oogum Boogum are perfectly positioned to capitalise on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Storm Home
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow with no pressure on The Cheeky Pup
scenarios.body: The field bunches up dramatically, creating a sprint finish that suits the talented closers with superior RPR figures. Journey So Far and Annie Button benefit from the condensed finish despite giving away ground early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fade Factor Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple pace-setters show their known stamina limitations in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The Cheeky Pup, Johnny M, and other noted faders weaken simultaneously, creating opportunities for horses without that specific weakness. Spellacy's Cross and Queen Kulina benefit from their more reliable stamina patterns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Trainer Form Delivers
scenarios.trigger: If Ross O'Sullivan's recent 4/15 strike rate continues with Walking In Mayo improving
scenarios.body: The trainer's decent recent form overcomes the horse's tendency to fade, delivering an upset result. Walking In Mayo benefits from tactical improvement and trainer confidence.

watchPoints.text: The Cheeky Pup's 286-day layoff combined with his fade tendency could see him weaken dramatically after setting the pace
Journey So Far carries top weight at 166lbs and has RPR 110 but his fade pattern makes him unreliable despite the class
Multiple apprentice jockeys including Eoghan Finegan (7lb), Miss Georgie Benson (7lb), and Jordan Canavan (7lb) could make tactical errors in a 20-runner field
Annie Button running again just 3 days after her last race with Jack Kennedy aboard suggests connections are confident
Written In My Soul's perfect 7/7 record on good going makes the surface conditions ideal for his chances
